verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents an official MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible agent read and write access to CRM data including contacts, and the contacts API supports creating a record via POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts, so the record-creation step is covered. The pack shows no API or MCP path for filling company data or enrichment (companies appear only in import and domain-deduplication docs) and nothing on assigning an owner. Missing for 10: documented company enrichment or company-association via API/MCP, documented owner-assignment via API/MCP, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.
